summary: Third task-gate cold read of cache-bug-T1, run after the decomposition was re-recorded with leaf-only required-test ids. Six findings, all repository-answerable: five folded into one amendment of the task contract and task plan, and the sixth (the approved story plan's stale prose) ledgered as D-0082 with a human-chosen trigger after Ravi weighed the plan re-ceremony cost. Frontier closed.
gaps: The task plan named an undefined DeepAgentTurnFailure wrapper, placed QueryFailure in runner/types.ts rather than its real module, and stated no rule preserving close-driven AbortError identity, so a literal implementation could turn a graceful stop into an error frame.
The previously recorded task grill is bound to e7a09d791 and to a contract that has since changed twice; it must not authorise a handover.
Write scope granted the broad prefixes apps/core/src/app, apps/core/test/unit and apps/core/test/integration, permitting changes unrelated to the named files.
The manual error proof used an invalid model credential, which fails before any usage is accumulated and so cannot demonstrate a usage-bearing error frame.
contradictions: The approved story plan says all four callers switch to retireProviderSession and prescribes blocking full npm run lint, contradicting decision 0159 §4 and the settled lint:changed ruling that the task contract already carries.

Contract text was internally inconsistent: the manual check and the decomposition objective claimed verify.py runs full npm run lint, and Surface Impact said nine required tests against a contract naming 25.
resolutions: D-0082 ledgered (plans/deferrals.md): the plan body is approval-digest bound, so correcting it forces a fresh plan cold read plus a human re-approval and re-stales the decomposition binding. Ravi chose on 2026-09-10 to pay that ceremony after cache-bug-T1 merges and before cache-bug-T2 starts, so T2's implementer never reads the stale prose. Decision 0159 §4 and the task contract govern in the meantime.

Task plan step 3 rewritten: DeepAgentPartialUsage is the thrown value itself, no wrapper type; the abort exception is stated explicitly (partialUsageEvents rethrows the AbortError, normalizeDeepAgentStream attaches the usage as a non-enumerable property, runner/index.ts exits cleanly with no error frame). QueryFailure's owner corrected to runner/query-failure.exception.ts. AC2 amended to carry the abort-identity rule, and two required tests added: the unit abort seam and the Node-24 boundary _close test, both probed green against the recorded gate command before recording.
Superseded: this record is the fresh cold read against HEAD 28bc58a1 and the twice-amended contract; the stale record is replaced in place.
The decomposition objective and task plan step 5 now say lint:changed is the blocking gate with full npm run lint advisory; Surface Impact corrected to 27 required tests.

Write scope narrowed: the three prefixes are replaced by the two runtime-app files, the thirteen unit test files and the one integration test file this task actually touches (39 entries, every one of them in the diff or a declared new file).

Manual step 4 rewritten to force the failure after at least one usage event has been accumulated (a local gateway that streams a usage-bearing chunk then closes mid-turn), and to state explicitly why an invalid credential is not a valid proof.
current_flow: A turn resumes its persisted provider session and the runner appends a fresh briefing, so context grows without bound across restarts. T1 adds only measurement and retirement plumbing: modelVisibleInputTokens derives model-visible input from the route's two cache-inclusion booleans; errored turns carry one cumulative partial-usage payload (QueryFailure for Claude, DeepAgentPartialUsage for DeepAgents, with close-driven aborts keeping their identity and carrying the usage as an attached property); provider_sessions.context_high_water_mark stores the mark; raise and retireProviderSession are fenced on id, owner, status and the null-safe reset_at generation; resetScope returns the references it removed. Nothing reads the mark and nothing releases a reference yet — the ceiling is T2 and the release is T3.

criteria_map.S1 derivation: modelVisibleInputTokens r: modelVisibleInputTokens in shared/model-usage.ts resolves the route from usage.modelRoute with the usage.provider fallback at model-usage.ts:55 and switches on the two booleans; the three arithmetic cases plus the fallback are required tests 1-3 and 24 in model-visible-input-tokens.test.ts.
criteria_map.S2/R2 partial usage, spawned runners: an: Read at the seam: DeepAgentPartialUsage in stream-normalizer-partial-usage.ts is the only carrier and is thrown directly (no wrapper type exists); partialUsageEvents rethrows an AbortError unwrapped and normalizeDeepAgentStream attaches the usage via a non-enumerable Symbol, so runner/index.ts:294 still recognises the abort. QueryFailure is in runner/query-failure.exception.ts. Proven by required tests 14, 15, 18, 26 and the Node-24 boundary _close test 27, probed green before recording.
criteria_map.S2/R2 partial usage, inline lanes: an er: Both inline lanes emit one terminal error output carrying accumulated usage; required tests 16 and 19.
criteria_map.S3 storage: provider_sessions.context_hi: Column, generated migration and snapshot are in the diff; raise/reject semantics are required tests 6, 7 and 11.
criteria_map.R1 fences: raise and retireProviderSessi: Both operations compare agent_sessions.reset_at with IS NOT DISTINCT FROM; the null/null and null-vs-non-null cases are required test 8.
criteria_map.R1 retirement: retireProviderSession is: retireProviderSession is one fenced active→expired UPDATE with RETURNING; the three switched callers and the unchanged compaction-delta path are required tests 9, 12 and 13, matching decision 0159 §4 (the story plan still says four callers — ledgered as D-0082).
criteria_map.R3 registry: every executable route's ca: Both booleans are declared per executable route and the validator rejects a route missing either; required tests 4 and 5.
criteria_map.R4 return type: resetScope returns an im: resetScope returns an immutable list selected FOR UPDATE before delete and returned after commit; propagation through the facade and clearSessionForChatJid is required tests 10 and 25; no caller releases yet.
criteria_map.S11 lint gate: a package.json script lin: lint:changed exists in package.json:76 with the -- terminator, runs inside FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD and as the blocking CI step, full lint stays advisory; the 82 pre-existing errors are the ledgered deferral (recorded as D-0080 in this task's sealed records, renumbered to D-0081 after an id collision on main).
criteria_map.S10 unchanged behaviour: the four pinned: The four pinned tests are required tests 20-23 and untouched by the diff; verify.py green on Node 24.

rounds.question: The re-grill found the approved story plan still says all four callers switch to retireProviderSession (decision 0159 §4 keeps compaction-delta on expireProviderSession) and still prescribes blocking full `npm run lint` (settled ruling is `lint:changed` blocking, full lint advisory). When should that happen?
options: After T1 merges, before T2 starts (Recommended)

rounds.question: Closing round for the re-grilled T1 task gate. All six findings are folded into one amendment: the carrier contract now names DeepAgentPartialUsage as the only shape and states the abort-identity rule (AC2 amended, plus two new required tests — the unit abort seam and the Node-24 boundary _close test, both probed green); QueryFailure's owner corrected to runner/query-failure.exception.ts; the objective and task plan now say lint:changed blocking / full lint advisory; the required-test count corrected to 27; write scope narrowed from the three broad prefixes to the 15 files this task actually touches; the manual error proof replaced with a controlled failure after a usage event; the stale grill record is superseded by this one; and the story-plan contradiction is ledgered as D-0082 to be fixed in the re-ceremony you scheduled between T1's merge and T2's start. Any remaining gap before I record the gate, approve T1 as Ravi, and run the review?
options: No remaining gap, record and approve (Recommended)
